appearances.newly_possible: Developers can now deploy 238M English and 776M multilingual open speech recognition models under MIT, with a community MLX port already available for Apple silicon.
appearances.why: A 238M MIT model reported to beat Whisper large-v3 on the Open ASR English subset sharply cuts compute and licensing friction for local transcription.
appearances.limits: The Whisper large-v3 comparison is self-reported by Sber on the Open ASR English subset, without independent latency or noise tests.
